name: smwmusic-stellar-echo
title: Stellar Echo
description:
This is an original song created by Alfombra de Madera (me), Jon, Cemstrumental, and Clonazepan.

I started this project as an experiment. I composed the base of the song and then shared it with some friends. Each of them added their own contributions, and later I ported the song to the SNES.

Jon composed almost all of the melody.

Cemstrumental created all the samples.

Clonazepan made the drums for the first part.

I handled the SNES port, the chords, the bass, and the final section of the song.

And yes, this is technically a port, since the original version of the song was made in Famitracker.

You can find the original version on my YouTube channel.
